Chat Completions + tools in this file: gpt-6-luna returns HTTP 400 for function tools on Chat Completions unless reasoning_effort is 'none' (docs + live-tested). Set it, or move to the Responses API.
Fine-tune of gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18; per OpenAI it shuts down with its base model on 2027-01-14.

No automatic replacement: gpt-6-luna does not support fine-tuning. Options are prompting/few-shot on gpt-6-luna validated with `eval`, or re-training on a fine-tunable model (none confirmed by the kit). New fine-tuning jobs stop on 6 Jan 2027.
Uses `max_tokens`: gpt-6-luna rejects it with HTTP 400 (live-tested). Rename to `max_completion_tokens` (Chat Completions) or `max_output_tokens` (Responses).
Structured output in this file: gpt-6-luna lists structured_outputs as supported; verify schemas with `eval`.
Sets temperature/top_p/logprobs: gpt-6-luna accepts these only with reasoning_effort 'none'; at other efforts temperature must be 1 and top_p/logprobs return HTTP 400 (live-tested).
